d: In the Bihar Assembly elections, the star campaigner who generated the most buzz from the NDA side was Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. CM Yogi marked his presence in as many as 31 assembly constituencies in just 10 days. He addressed public rallies in some places, held roadshows in others, and even went door-to-door on foot marches seeking votes. The notable thing is that most of the seats where CM Yogi held rallies or roadshows have either been won by the BJP or are currently leading. CM Yogi began his campaign in Bihar on October 16.
